verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is an agent-facing CLI, MCP server and API over process guides and company records, so bulk operations are a fair question for it. The evidence documents only single-item operations: one record or run at a time, per-record revisioned updates, and cursor pagination for reading the catalog. Nothing shows a batch or multi-item operation, and pagination and per-record saves are adjacent features rather than bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
